# TRT World

> > TRT World is a global news network providing comprehensive coverage of international conflicts, Middle East geopolitics, diplomacy, and humanitarian crises with a focus on Türkiye's perspective.

TRT World delivers breaking news, analysis, and video journalism covering major global events including the Iran-Israel conflict, Ukraine-Russia war, Gaza humanitarian crisis, and diplomatic relations involving the United States, Türkiye, China, India, and other key nations. The network features original programming, digital video content, and in-depth reporting on elections, sanctions, energy infrastructure, and regional security.

## Key Topics

- Middle East conflict
- Iran-Israel tensions
- Türkiye foreign policy
- Gaza humanitarian crisis
- Ukraine-Russia war
- International diplomacy
- US geopolitics
- UN humanitarian operations
- Regional security
- Sanctions and economic pressure
- Conflict zones
- Breaking news coverage
- Energy and infrastructure
- Global elections
- Media freedom and disinformation

## Breaking News & Core Coverage

- [TRT World - News](https://www.trtworld.com/news): Breaking news hub: Philippines Bangsamoro region, global headlines
- [TRT World - World](https://www.trtworld.com/world): Global news: Middle East conflict, Israel-Iran war, UN humanitarian crisis
- [TRT World - War on Iran](https://www.trtworld.com/war-on-iran): Live coverage: Iran-Israel-US conflict, Strait of Hormuz crisis

## Video & Multimedia

- [TRT World - TV Shows](https://www.trtworld.com/video/tv/shows): TV shows schedule: STRAIT TALK, ROUNDTABLE, THE NEWSMAKERS programming
- [TRT World - Digital Video](https://www.trtworld.com/video/digital): Digital video news: TikTok, US-India-Russia geopolitics, video journalism

## Conflict & Peace Processes

- [TRT World - Conflict & Peace Processes](https://www.trtworld.com/conflict-peace-processes): Ukraine-Russia war, Gaza ceasefire, Hungary-EU tensions, peace diplomacy
- [TRT World - Humanitarian Aid](https://www.trtworld.com/humanitarian-aid): UN/UNICEF relief efforts in Gaza, Sudan, conflict zone displacement
- [TRT World - Development & Aid Programs](https://www.trtworld.com/development-aid-programs): Gaza reconstruction, World Bank aid, mine action in conflict zones

## Regional Coverage

- [TRT World - Türkiye](https://www.trtworld.com/turkiye): Erdogan foreign policy, Turkey-Iran-US relations, regional security
- [TRT World - Americas](https://www.trtworld.com/americas): US-Iran tensions, Trump administration, Latin America cartel coverage
- [TRT World - Africa](https://www.trtworld.com/africa): DRC mining disaster, Goma conflict, terrorism, refugee displacement crisis

## Diplomacy & International Relations

- [TRT World - Diplomacy & Foreign Policy](https://www.trtworld.com/diplomacy-foreign-policy): Türkiye-Ethiopia relations, Erdogan diplomacy, Red Sea regional stability
- [TRT World - Sanctions & Diplomacy Pressure](https://www.trtworld.com/sanctions-diplomacy-pressure): Macron diplomacy, US-Iran sanctions, Russia-Ukraine geopolitical pressure
- [TRT World - Elections & Politics](https://www.trtworld.com/elections-politics): Global elections coverage: Nepal RSP, Peru politics, democratic transitions

## Economy & Infrastructure

- [TRT World - Global Economy & Markets](https://www.trtworld.com/global-economy-markets): Federal Reserve policy, Trump economics, oil prices, Turkey-Oman markets
- [TRT World - Energy & Infrastructure](https://www.trtworld.com/energy-infrastructure): EU renewables, Turkey-Ukraine pipelines, Greenpeace, nuclear energy policy

## Society & Technology

- [TRT World - Disinformation & Media](https://www.trtworld.com/disinformation-media): Media freedom, India-Kashmir censorship, surveillance & social media control
- [TRT World - Technology & Innovation](https://www.trtworld.com/technology-innovation): AI ethics, China-US military tech, UAV drones, space exploration coverage
- [TRT World - Culture](https://www.trtworld.com/culture): UNESCO heritage, Iran sites, Trump-era media bias, entertainment industry
- [TRT World - Sport](https://www.trtworld.com/sport): FIFA World Cup, Champions League, Iran-US sports, Galatasaray coverage
